scientific_integrity: The universal theorem rests on the finite transfer-matrix bijection, two complete exact characteristic-polynomial certificates, and formal trace identities. Independent audit and historical-priority determination have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only labelled simple prisms of length at least three and named palettes of three or four are classified. The same constrained-colouring count may occur as a special case of an unlocated broader formula; no independent priority certification is claimed.
title: Optimal proper conflict-free colouring census for cycle prisms
